content: Every weekday at 7:30, summarise the overnight build failures into notes/builds.md.

attachment.prompt: Also check the build log for tests marked flaky.

message.content: Summarise last night's failures for the support team.

content.text: I will group the failures by stack trace and quote each trace in full, then look up owners in CODEOWNERS.

message.content: No. The support team will not read stack traces. Say which feature broke and who to ask, in plain words.

content.text: CODEOWNERS only names reviewers; the person to ask about each feature is in notes/owners.jsonl.
Checkout broke last night: ask Priya. Search broke twice: ask Tom.

message.content: Good. Keep summaries short in general.

content.text: The search tests failed twice with no change to the search code, and the log does not say why.

message.content: That lock is left by git status from the VM. Use git --no-optional-locks status there, and remove the stale lock.

content.text: Removed the stale lock; git --no-optional-locks status is clean, and notes/builds.md is staged.
